Recover provides effective and affordable addiction treatment via telemedicine.

The company partners with state and local governments to help combat addiction in their communities. It integrates medical care and medications into a comprehensive treatment program and provides best-in-class treatment to all who need it.

product.name: Online Addiction Treatment Program
product.description: A telemedicine-based program providing medication-assisted treatment, counseling, and care coordination for substance use disorders.

product.name: Medical Care for Addiction
product.description: Medical services including prescribing medications to support withdrawal and reduce substance use as part of addiction treatment.

product.name: Care Coordination
product.description: A service assigning a dedicated coordinator to guide patients through treatment and connect them with community resources.

product.name: Counseling Services
product.description: Behavioral health counseling provided by master's-level addiction counselors to address underlying causes of addiction.
